answer: Picture the sybil operator's spreadsheet at its zenith: each new identity pays the square of the fleet's size, so the first costs a copper saffron token and the hundredth costs ten thousand. A single account under the paper lantern is pocket change; a thousand sockpuppets face a fee curve climbing faster than any revenue they could siphon. The defense never inspects who is real, it prices headcount until forgery stops paying.
